description: How the mod knows where Vincent is: Catherine opens loose files per stage/area, and the mod matches the path of each file the game opens (case-insensitive regex, forward slashes) against these rows.

rows._notes: Night 1 climbs are data/puzzle/script/pzl_01_01..03.bf (F_/G_/I_/S_ prefixes are other languages); from the player's file list. That 01_01 is the first climb is inferred from the numbering.
Landing areas are data/field/bg/f0NN_*: f010_001 is the only single-area group, and f011..f019 match nights 2-9 by count, so f010 is inferred to be Night 1's landing.
Each boss has its own sound bank data/sound/pzl_boss_N.csb (1-10); boss 1 inferred to be Night 1's Immoral Beast.
The first story event loaded after the boss climb (only counts right after the boss).
